name: Orbi
description: Orbi is an open-source AI GitHub App that turns GitHub issues into merged pull requests: it plans the change, writes the code, opens the PR, answers review and fixes CI until it is ready to merge. Self-hostable (https://github.com/orbi-build/orbi, AGPL-3.0) or hosted Orbi Cloud with the first 3 merged pull requests free, no credit card needed.
